headline: Shelley Fabares, ‘Donna Reed Show’ Actress, Dies at 82
context: She also starred in Elvis Presley movies and the sitcom “Coach.” Somewhat reluctantly, she had a No. 1 hit in 1962 with “Johnny Angel.”
